primary_paper_urls.title: GR00T 2 technical whitepaper
primary_paper_urls.verification: Linked from the official GR00T 2 project page. This audit verified the outlink and readable project Agentic Control section; the PDF crawler returned HTTP 200 with no readable text, so the PDF body is not claimed reviewed.

perspectives.scope_note: Direct GR00T 2 technical material and its ASPIRE recovery system accompany the talk. PhysCaP and MobiAgent are separate research systems illustrating belief/program changes or deployment-time planning; their results are not attributed to Jim Fan.

ASPIRE is the named skill-acquisition source. HARBOR/ENPIRE organize numerical policy learning, while EmbodiedSWE generates supervision for VLA fine-tuning. Argon assists a team workflow; it does not demonstrate autonomous neural-weight training by itself.

Roberto supplies the recorded framing; these papers investigate retention or repeated refinement. Memory Anchors is training replay, MobiAgent updates a fixed inventory and plateaus, and ASPIRE does not claim a fully autonomous real-world lifelong learner.
